gate_findings.evidence: Ca hai loi G6 cua r002 da het, kiem bang TAI LAP chu khong doc code. (1) remaining_service_life(cover_mm=40, age=10, carbonation) + measured={chloride:{cs_percent:2.1,d_ref_m2s:8.0e-12}} nay tra SCREENING_DEFAULT (truoc la MEASURED) trong khi so van 108.0 - het thoi phong provenance. (2) load_exposure_data voi ccrit_percent=-5.0 nay bi tu choi bang ExposureDataError 'ccrit_percent phai duong'. KHONG SUA QUA TAY: measured={rh_percent:80} van cho MEASURED va doi so that 108.0->118.7, tuc nhan bam dung viec gia tri co duoc ap vao hay khong. Ba ca bien tu kiem them deu dung: chloride + rh_percent khong lien quan -> SCREENING_DEFAULT va so khong doi; chloride + du lieu clorua that -> MEASURED va so doi 7.1->11.3; mechanism la -> raise ValueError chu khong am tham tra ket qua. G6 dat O PHAN MA TASK NAY CO THE GIAO: mo hinh khau hao design-life + duong nap du lieu do co kiem fail-closed + nhan provenance trung thuc. Phan du lieu vat lieu/exposure THAT la human gate theo PROTOCOL muc 'Orchestration tu dong' (G6 vat lieu/exposure that luon dung cho con nguoi), nam ngoai kha nang moi agent, khong tinh vao task nay. Quan trong: khi chua co du lieu that thi moi dau ra deu mang SCREENING_DEFAULT nen khong the ro ri thanh khai bang chung khong co.
